instruction: Study the failed evolution-space expansion result and your own evolutionary controller source. Determine why new experience cannot create a previously absent evolutionary class. Then use only your existing native mechanisms and your own accumulated experience to solve that limitation. Do not wait for the host to name a new chromosome, schema, mutation rule, target function, or patch.
pass_only_if: YADO studies the exact failed result
YADO studies the source structure of its own evolutionary controller
YADO retains the diagnosis as experience
a native attempt is made after study
the resulting child has a structurally broader evolutionary space than the parent
the new class is not named or schematized by the host
